The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7fd6eb0adc06ad82), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix the sites and a generic common twist as in Proposition 6.1, and denote the specialized trace by τ0. There are finitely many points p(ν) ∈ (C∗)N , integers mν ≥ 0, and constants cν,α such that, for every f ∈ A, τ0(f) = X ν X |α|≤mν cν,α ∂α pf(p(ν) ). (6.13) Here α ∈ ZN ≥0, |α| = P i αi, and repeated points are combined and zero local functionals omitted. Every remaining point satisfies the coefficients of the cleared relation Q(w)Q(w − 1)(L − P) = 0; consequently L = P there as a rational identity in the spectral argument. Such a point may have colliding roots. At a regular transverse solution in the original configuration locus, the contribution is the ordinary trace term Wf/J, with J as in (6.4); its weight is nonzero whenever W ̸= 0.
